biography_rule: Before 2026-09-08 a draft has only an undated private or professional background: no public office, party membership, candidacy or election. Every political step is a conditional gameplay possibility inside the window.

role_catalog.office: Premier secrétaire du Parti socialiste (First Secretary of the Socialist Party)
role_catalog.legal_minimum_age_note: The membership floor; no separate age rule for the First Secretary was found.

plausibility_band.basis: authored game assumption, not a legal rule

eligibility_rules.text: Elected by secret ballot of all members from the first signatories of the two leading national orientation motions; after a prolonged vacancy the National Council elects a First Secretary until the next congress.
The First Secretary presides over the Bureau national, whose members need three consecutive years of membership.
The national congress meets within six months after presidential and legislative elections and at mid-term.
The internal rules add no further candidacy condition.
Parties form and act freely under the Constitution.

role_catalog.executive_policy: party_only: a party first secretary is not a national executive (existing France institution record in spheres-sim/data/party_executive_eligibility.json).
repository_evidence: spheres-sim/data/party_leaders.json fr_ps identity_note separates the first secretary from the President, Prime Minister and presidential nominee, and labels provisional/acting leadership separately.

role_catalog.office: Secrétaire national du Parti communiste français (National Secretary)
role_catalog.legal_minimum_age_note: No age rule was found in the 39th Congress statutes; the authored band applies.

plausibility_band.basis: authored game assumption, not a legal rule

eligibility_rules.text: The congress meets at least every three years.
Governing bodies are elected on lists; each list proposes a secretary, and the secretary is the person whose list obtains the most votes.
The same executive function is generally limited to nine years; elected bodies are gender-balanced.

repository_evidence: spheres-sim/data/party_leaders.json fr_pcf identity_note: the title became national secretary in 1994 and a presidency is not interchangeable with it.

role_catalog.office: Candidate for President of the Republic (presidential contender)
role_catalog.legal_minimum_age_note: Read through the ministry memento because Légifrance and the Conseil constitutionnel were blocked.

plausibility_band.basis: authored game assumption, not a legal rule

eligibility_rules.text: Five-year term by direct universal suffrage; no more than two consecutive terms; two-round absolute-majority election.
Eligibility: French, aged 18, elector status, not deprived of eligibility, not under guardianship, national-service obligations met.
At least 500 presentations by listed elected officials from at least 30 departments or overseas collectivities, no more than one tenth from any one.
In a vacancy the President of the Senate acts provisionally and a new election follows within 20 to 35 days; the President appoints the Prime Minister.

role_catalog.executive_policy: presidential_contender: France requires an explicit future_office_grants entry before any new named national executive (spheres-sim/data/party_executive_eligibility.json institutions[France]).

role_catalog.office: Député(e) à l'Assemblée nationale (one of 577 seats), with an optional parliamentary-group presidency

plausibility_band.basis: authored game assumption, not a legal rule

eligibility_rules.text: 577 deputies elected by direct suffrage for five years; an organic law fixes eligibility and incompatibilities.
French, aged at least 18, enjoying civic rights, outside every ineligibility; one constituency only.
No combination with a local executive function.
Groups need at least fifteen members and name their president in a signed political declaration.
After a dissolution elections follow within 20 to 40 days and no new dissolution may occur for a year; Government members may not hold a parliamentary mandate.

role_catalog.executive_policy: not an executive role; the current single-office engine has no deputy or group seat.
repository_evidence: spheres-sim/src/government.rs France polity: ruling "the National Assembly", two-round elections every 60 months; no individual seats.

role_catalog.office: Representative of the people in the Legislative Assembly (one of 17 people's seats)

plausibility_band.basis: authored game assumption, not a legal rule

eligibility_rules.text: Seventeen people's representatives are elected by qualified electors; the nine nobles' seats are elected by and from the nobles.
Electors are Tongan subjects aged 21 or more who are not nobles and not disqualified; a candidate stands only where registered and has no outstanding court order for a specific sum.
Nomination on Form 4 signed by 50 constituency electors, a non-refundable $400 deposit and court clearances.
Sentences over two years disqualify from candidacy and any Government office unless pardoned.
General elections every four years unless earlier dissolved; by-elections follow death, resignation or impeachment.

role_catalog.office: Prime Minister, reached only through a people's representative seat
role_catalog.organization: Office of the Prime Minister / Cabinet
role_catalog.legal_minimum_age_note: Via the people's-seat qualification; the nobles' route is hereditary and excluded.

plausibility_band.basis: authored game assumption, not a legal rule

eligibility_rules.text: The King appoints as Prime Minister an elected representative recommended by the Assembly under the Schedule or clause 50B.
Nominations seconded by two elected representatives; secret ballot with elimination until one candidate has more than half; the Speaker runs the same procedure for other vacancies.
A no-confidence motion has no effect within 18 months after a general election, within six months before the election deadline or within 12 months of a previous motion.
The premiership can also be reached from a nobles' seat; fictional drafts may use only the people's route.

role_catalog.executive_policy: No Tonga executive-role record exists (reviewed_office_role has no Tonga entry); a Tonga institution record would be needed first.

role_catalog.office: Cabinet Minister who is not an elected representative (at most four at a time)
role_catalog.legal_minimum_age_note: Clause 51 sets no age; the authored band applies.

plausibility_band.basis: authored game assumption, not a legal rule

eligibility_rules.text: Ministers are nominated by the Prime Minister and appointed by the King; no more than four may be non-elected; the Cabinet is collectively responsible.

A non-elected Minister sits and votes in the Assembly except in no-confidence votes, represents no constituency and leaves office on revocation, 50B, death, resignation, impeachment dismissal or ineligibility.
Sentences over two years disqualify from any office under the Government unless pardoned.

role_catalog.executive_policy: Collective executive seat; no runtime seat model exists.

plausibility_band.basis: authored game assumption, not a legal rule

excluded_roles.reason: Hereditary succession by lawful descent; a fictional holder would manufacture royal parentage, and the succession is entrenched against amendment.

excluded_roles.office: Heir, member of the Royal Family, or Prince Regent
excluded_roles.reason: Membership of the Royal Family and the heirship are matters of descent; a regency is a royal appointment or a ballot without the people's representatives. Any fictional holder would invent royal parentage.

excluded_roles.office: Noble (holder of a hereditary title and estate)
excluded_roles.reason: Titles and estates pass by a fixed law of succession and are protected from removal and amendment; a fictional title-holder would manufacture a peerage and a lineage.

excluded_roles.office: Representative of the nobles (one of nine nobles' seats)
excluded_roles.reason: Elected by the nobles from their own number, so eligibility depends on holding a hereditary title.

excluded_roles.office: Speaker and Deputy Speaker of the Legislative Assembly
excluded_roles.reason: The Speaker must be an elected nobles' representative, so the office is reachable only through a hereditary title.

Not hereditary in itself, but members are called at the King's pleasure, with no gameplay selection path, and the Council finally decides hereditary title and estate appeals. Excluded from this pilot.
The republican form of government cannot be revised; there is no hereditary public office to propose.

excluded_roles.office: Prime Minister and members of the Government
excluded_roles.reason: Not proposed in this pilot: appointment is at the President's choice, Government membership excludes a parliamentary mandate, and the single-office engine has no separate Prime Minister.

biography.background_before_cutoff: An invented public-finance specialist who managed budget-reform programmes for a regional development organisation in the Pacific and later taught public administration at a tertiary institute in Nuku'alofa.
biography.hypothetical_path_after_cutoff: In play a Prime Minister could nominate her as one of the few Cabinet Ministers who are not elected representatives; she would take a ministry only after formal appointment by the King on that nomination. She would sit and vote in the Assembly, but not in a vote of no confidence, and would retain office until a constitutionally defined termination. After a general election she would remain a caretaker until her appointment is revoked or continued on the incoming Prime Minister's recommendation; the election date alone does not remove her.
